videos.title: The tool nobody buys until they need it
videos.hook: This sits on the shelf for months. Then someone needs it in an emergency.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait — no self-filming for this client.
videos.caption: The stuff you don't think about until you really need it. That's what we're here for.

videos.title: 40 years behind the counter
videos.hook: Four decades. Same corner. Here's what changed.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: Forty years of helping this town fix things. A short look back.

videos.title: How to actually pick the right screw
videos.hook: Ask him this question and watch him light up.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: The five-minute answer that'll save you three trips back to the store.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Straight interview answer, cut down to the essential 45s — no B-roll needed, his energy carries it.
editorBrief.mustKeep: The moment he picks up three different screws to demonstrate — don't cut around it.
editorBrief.captionsStyle: Burned-in captions, larger font (older-skewing audience reads this too).
editorBrief.musicVibe: None, or barely-there — let him talk.
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Come ask him yourself — he loves this stuff.

videos.title: Why he still hand-writes the receipts
videos.hook: Everyone asks why there's no card reader. Here's his answer.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: Some things don't need fixing. This is one of them.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Cold open on the receipt book, then his explanation.
editorBrief.mustKeep: The line "people remember a handshake, not a receipt code."
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Some things are worth keeping the old way.

videos.title: The regular who's been coming since 1998
videos.hook: One customer, one store, twenty-six years.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: Twenty-six years of showing up. That's the real story here.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Split between the regular's memory and his own.
editorBrief.mustKeep: Both of them laughing at the same old joke.
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Loyalty isn't a program here. It's just how it works.

videos.title: What he keeps in his truck, always
videos.hook: Five things. Never leaves without them.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: The five things that live in his truck, no matter what.

videos.title: The busiest week of the year
videos.hook: Storm season means one thing at this store.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview, shot on location by Tait.
videos.caption: When the forecast turns, so does this place. Here's what that week looks like.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Interview intercut with (described, not filmed) rush footage.
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Stock up before the storm, not during it.
